title: nonzeros
summary: Return nonzero elements in column-major order.

gpu_support.notes: `nonzeros` gathers dense GPU input before scanning because sparse helper outputs are host values in this slice.

description: `nonzeros(A)` returns a full column vector containing the nonzero elements of `A` in column-major order.
behaviors: Sparse input returns the stored sparse values in CSC column order.
Dense numeric input is scanned in column-major order and zeros are omitted.
Logical input returns double ones for true elements.
Complex input returns a complex column vector and omits only elements whose real and imaginary parts are both zero.

faqs.question: Is the output sparse?
faqs.answer: No. MATLAB returns a full column vector, and RunMat does the same.

points: `A` may be sparse, dense numeric, logical, scalar, or complex numeric.

gpu_residency: `nonzeros` gathers dense GPU tensors before scanning. A future provider path can preserve residency for dense GPU reductions and compaction.
